text:
Priya (People Ops): Quick heads up — Arun's birthday is this Friday (25th). Thinking a small get-together in the kitchen at 3pm. Remote folks get an e-card + option to mail a care package. Preferences so I can plan? :tada:

Jamahl (Eng): I can be there. Prefer savory over cake (mini sandwiches?). :sandwich:

Leo (Design): I will bring a small chocolate cake (nut-free). Where do we keep candles in the office?

Samira (Product): Can we do a non-food option too? Desk succulent or plant would be lovely for his desk. Also +1 for a quick Zoom drop-in for remote folks.

Nina (Contractor): Remote — I'll send a $25 e-gift. If people want to chip in for a bigger gift let me know.

Priya (People Ops): sweet — plan for 3pm. Quick poll: react with one of these or reply: :cake: = cake, :sandwich: = savory, :tada: = snacks, :herb: = plant/desksucculent. If you'll mail something write "I'll mail a care package". Also we need 2 volunteers to help set up at 2:50pm.

Jamahl (Eng): reacted with :sandwich:

Leo (Design): reacted with :cake: (bringing the cake)

Samira (Product): reacted with :herb: — I'll grab a small succulent from the office plant closet or buy one if needed.

Nina (Contractor): I'll mail a care package — sending from remote.

Priya (People Ops): Awesome. PeopleOps Bot created an event: "Arun birthday — kitchen" Fri 15:00 PST. RSVP link: https://calendar.redwoodinc/example. PeopleOps Bot: Please add any dietary notes in the event.

PeopleOps Bot: Event created by Priya (People Ops) — attendees: 8 (estimated).

Jamahl (Eng): Happy to set up tables/plates at 2:50pm.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks — volunteers so far: Jamahl (set up) and Leo (cake). Samira please bring the plant. I'll handle napkins/utensils. Nina — thank you for the e-gift.

Samira (Product): Cool — see you all Friday! :party_parrot:
